svg.title: Figure 7: temporal and spatial expression peak order
svg.desc: Version 10. Panel A unchanged: eve/run/odd cycle 2 at stage 3.3. Panels B-D at stage 4.3: gt/mlpt, Kr/svb, and svb/eve3. Panels B and C use separate temporal cohorts. Panel C shows close temporal peak estimates and separated spatial maxima, with unresolved temporal order. Editable vector paths and live text, one layer.
